title: Compiling Autoregressive LLM Control into Policy-Exact Parallel Inference for Hierarchical RAG
abstract: arXiv:2610.30664v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models increasingly act as controllers in structured decision pipelines, yet their decisions are still executed by autoregressive text decoding. Hierarchical RAG is one such setting: at each frontier of a document tree, an LLM commits to $b$ of $k$ sections under an input-dependent action grammar, executed as either failure-prone free-form JSON or reliable but strictly serial grammar-constrained generation. We show that this serialization is unnecessary for bounded-horizon control: the reachable future forms a shallow action-prefix tree, which we compile --- one root prefill plus one tree-causal probe evaluate every prefix-conditioned action distribution with serial decoding's tokens, positions, and causal ancestry. A prefix-state lemma makes compiled control policy-exact in exact arithmetic: the same policy with a two-forward critical path and zero output tokens. translated_title: 将自回归LLM控制编译为面向分层RAG的策略精确并行推理
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型越来越多地在结构化决策流水线中充当控制器，但其决策仍然通过自回归文本解码来执行。分层RAG（Hierarchical RAG）正是这样一种场景：在文档树的每个前沿节点，LLM需要在依赖输入的动作语法约束下，从k个章节中选定b个进行提交，其执行方式要么是容易出错的自由格式JSON，要么是可靠但严格串行的语法约束生成。我们证明，对于有界视界控制而言，这种串行化是不必要的：可达的未来形成一个浅层的动作前缀树，我们将其编译——仅需一次根预填充加一次树因果探测，即可利用串行解码所对应的token、位置和因果祖先，评估每个前缀条件下的动作分布。一个前缀状态引理保证编译后的控制在精确算术意义下达到策略精确：即相同的策略，但关键路径仅包含两次前向计算且零输出token。再经过一次探测过程即可验证精确的序边际化……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出将分层RAG中自回归LLM的控制决策编译为策略精确的并行推理——只需一次根预填充加一次树因果探测，即可在两次前向计算的关键路径、零输出token的条件下，精确复现串行语法约束解码的动作分布。
en_tdlr: This paper compiles autoregressive LLM control in hierarchical RAG into policy-exact parallel inference, where one root prefill plus one tree-causal probe reproduces the exact prefix-conditioned action distributions of serial grammar-constrained decoding with only a two-forward-pass critical path and zero output tokens.
